description: This file contains a series of shell test scripts for testing various 'git pull' options and behaviors, including rebase, verbose output, strict argument handling, dry-run mode, handling of unrelated histories, signoff, and verification flags.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output is empty.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a given message.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a reference is missing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up hook scripts for testing.
